23eaec69a1a8e4f1e50e409db1c32d9988545711.french: Cependant, une tradition ne justifie ni de forcer un enfant à la suivre ni de porter atteinte aux droits des autres. 261f0b67940451ab3e0a27e0e6e352d2d885cd42.english: These points of reference help us to feel at ease, whilst continuing to learn the language and local customs.

3c91751a47fc129b747f38666d133c90c3e79b92.english: When many things change around us, returning to familiar routines helps us feel at home. We can thus keep an important part of ourselves rather than feel we have left it behind.

643b60d4821b9ab640a4871ad6bbf426be3d6711.english: A practice becomes a meeting point when we present it openly to others. Neighbours can ask questions and share their habits. These exchanges can enrich local life rather than separate groups.

b3e10b98b28540aebe6c75a8e9c4b48066d2ed92.english: When so much is changing around us, rediscovering familiar rituals helps us feel at home. In this way, we find a part of our former life within our new daily routine.

ccd35b66bcd6b1b9238499fb677b275b353ea1de.english: Preserving one’s culture can therefore also help one to participate in local life.

2b896096df6092ccb226077e6b78749501dc542b.english: No, I do not think watching television is necessarily a waste of time. It all depends on what you watch and how much space it takes up in your day. Time in front of a screen can have value without having to be productive.

ec12700fa965d5d1f9712ffda503bc15f9b4270a.french: En conclusion, regarder la télévision n'est pas une perte de temps en soi. Information, moments partagés et détente peuvent justifier ce choix, à condition que le programme et la durée correspondent réellement à ce que l'on cherche.
ec12700fa965d5d1f9712ffda503bc15f9b4270a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Culture revision; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

f2d4d2b555b5e09e2df6acc34f1887ea61f23016.english: Two sisters who live far apart are watching the same film. They then ring each other to discuss the character who goes to work abroad, leaving his parents behind. Each explains what she would have done in his place.
f2d4d2b555b5e09e2df6acc34f1887ea61f23016.french: Deux sœurs qui vivent loin l'une de l'autre regardent le même film. Elles s'appellent ensuite pour discuter du personnage qui part travailler à l'étranger en laissant ses parents. Chacune explique ce qu'elle aurait fait à sa place.

0171b8a39ecd9e36336faf39470591b41c456f61.english: First and foremost, books and documentaries allow us to discover other cultures without travelling.
0171b8a39ecd9e36336faf39470591b41c456f61.french: Tout d'abord, les livres et les documentaires permettent de découvrir d'autres cultures sans voyager.

028375a67c5e4a176c4a4a15fa33d4ea16051d61.english: In conclusion, books, meeting people locally and long-distance conversations can really help us discover other cultures. Travelling can complement these experiences, but it is not essential.
028375a67c5e4a176c4a4a15fa33d4ea16051d61.french: En conclusion, les livres, les rencontres près de chez soi et les conversations à distance peuvent vraiment nous faire découvrir d'autres cultures. Voyager peut compléter ces expériences, mais ce n'est pas indispensable.

207c7d6f493e7e6378b9530e2e4b3dc8b311e9f2.english: Yes, we can genuinely know other cultures without travelling. It is not about knowing everything about a country, but understanding some of its practices and their meaning. Resources and exchanges available from home already make this learning possible.
207c7d6f493e7e6378b9530e2e4b3dc8b311e9f2.french: Oui, on peut réellement connaître d'autres cultures sans voyager. Il ne s'agit pas de tout savoir sur un pays, mais d'en comprendre certaines pratiques et leur sens. Les ressources et les échanges accessibles depuis chez soi permettent déjà cet apprentissage.
207c7d6f493e7e6378b9530e2e4b3dc8b311e9f2.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

20c6a372bd5f4fe55b36f3eb6c0265a65a9aade1.deepl_english: For example, I could sign up for an Irish dance workshop in my neighbourhood. The instructor would show me a few steps, and then I’d try them out with the group. I could then dance with the others at the ball.
20c6a372bd5f4fe55b36f3eb6c0265a65a9aade1.english: For example, I could sign up for an Irish dance workshop in my neighbourhood. The instructor would show me a few steps, and then I’d try them out with the group. I could then dance with the others at the dance.
20c6a372bd5f4fe55b36f3eb6c0265a65a9aade1.french: Par exemple, je pourrais m'inscrire à un atelier de danse irlandaise dans mon quartier. L'animateur me montrerait quelques pas, puis je les essaierais avec le groupe. Je pourrais ensuite danser avec les autres au bal.
20c6a372bd5f4fe55b36f3eb6c0265a65a9aade1.review_note: Bal here is a social dance; ball unnecessarily suggests a formal event.

237b5c4b762323e3e1723ae1d5b0eed848694f44.deepl_english: Of course, these methods cannot replace all the experiences of a trip to the destination itself. A documentary can explain a festival, but it cannot make us experience its atmosphere in the streets.
237b5c4b762323e3e1723ae1d5b0eed848694f44.english: Of course, these methods cannot replace all the experiences of a trip to the destination itself. A documentary can explain a festival, but it cannot let us experience its atmosphere in the streets.
237b5c4b762323e3e1723ae1d5b0eed848694f44.french: Bien sûr, ces moyens ne remplacent pas toutes les expériences d'un séjour sur place. Un documentaire peut expliquer une fête, mais pas nous faire vivre son ambiance dans les rues.
237b5c4b762323e3e1723ae1d5b0eed848694f44.review_note: Make us experience is an unnatural literal rendering of nous faire vivre in this context.

37543c5b88024a56f4009848ea93123fad581b0a.english: A book or documentary can recount the history of a tradition and present a region's products. These explanations provide solid knowledge about places we may never have the opportunity to visit.
37543c5b88024a56f4009848ea93123fad581b0a.french: Un livre ou un documentaire peut raconter l'histoire d'une tradition et présenter les produits d'une région. Ces explications donnent des connaissances solides sur des lieux qu'on n'aura peut-être jamais l'occasion de visiter.
37543c5b88024a56f4009848ea93123fad581b0a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

390cfc30fbb3a4bfd2c3b1fb400a3e4ff0867e41.english: Finally, long-distance exchanges allow us to deepen our understanding of a culture.
390cfc30fbb3a4bfd2c3b1fb400a3e4ff0867e41.french: Enfin, les échanges à distance permettent d'approfondir sa connaissance d'une culture.

3b1f8c25332f4ffb2e15a09498ef8ee97d5489fa.deepl_english: Workshops and neighbourhood festivals offer the chance to discover customs from other places. By taking part, we learn the skills by doing them ourselves, with someone there to guide us.
3b1f8c25332f4ffb2e15a09498ef8ee97d5489fa.english: Workshops and neighbourhood festivals offer the chance to discover customs from other places. By taking part, we learn how to do things by trying them ourselves, with someone there to guide us.
3b1f8c25332f4ffb2e15a09498ef8ee97d5489fa.french: Les ateliers et les fêtes de quartier permettent de découvrir des pratiques venues d'ailleurs. En y participant, on apprend les gestes en les faisant soi-même, avec quelqu'un pour nous guider.
3b1f8c25332f4ffb2e15a09498ef8ee97d5489fa.review_note: Learn the skills by doing them is unnatural; apprendre les gestes describes learning practical actions through participation.

3f44bbd6c8445db55768211597c5a7359c42497a.english: Although a documentary does not let us experience a celebration's atmosphere, it explains its meaning. A stay also brings the smells and rhythm of places. But travel is not accessible to everyone, so these other means retain their full value.
3f44bbd6c8445db55768211597c5a7359c42497a.french: Bien qu'un documentaire ne fasse pas vivre l'ambiance d'une fête, il en explique le sens. Un séjour apporte aussi les odeurs et le rythme des lieux. Mais le voyage n'est pas accessible à tous : ces autres moyens gardent donc toute leur valeur.
3f44bbd6c8445db55768211597c5a7359c42497a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

40beadecf7d5953a82c0e7174334056d70b0ba64.english: For example, a West African cookery book can show you how to make rice with peanut sauce and introduce the local ingredients used in the recipe. It can also tell the story behind the dish.
40beadecf7d5953a82c0e7174334056d70b0ba64.french: Par exemple, un livre de cuisine ouest-africaine peut montrer comment préparer du riz avec une sauce aux arachides et présenter les produits locaux utilisés dans la recette. Il peut aussi raconter l'histoire de ce plat.

4b37683b867d83c26e638be03c90733bb70d9216.english: We can therefore gain a better understanding of certain customs, even without meeting people in person.
4b37683b867d83c26e638be03c90733bb70d9216.french: On peut donc mieux comprendre certaines habitudes, même sans se rencontrer en personne.

5bade6dd9d1772ce7f7f5bf1fb42257cf5cee043.english: In this way, we discover this tradition by sharing it with others, not just by observing it.
5bade6dd9d1772ce7f7f5bf1fb42257cf5cee043.french: On découvre ainsi cette tradition en la partageant avec d'autres personnes, pas seulement en la regardant.

73cdf921e83a17fbbbb0bd63a2f9d74fdf6b55b7.english: Furthermore, we can discover other cultures by taking part in activities close to home.
73cdf921e83a17fbbbb0bd63a2f9d74fdf6b55b7.french: Ensuite, on peut découvrir d'autres cultures en participant à des activités près de chez soi.

9f48aebd20be808bac5c54d6d4f95f689ddef0ac.english: Long-distance exchanges give us access to the perspectives of people from other cultures. We can ask our own questions and seek clarification on anything we haven’t understood.
9f48aebd20be808bac5c54d6d4f95f689ddef0ac.french: Les échanges à distance donnent accès au point de vue de personnes d'une autre culture. On peut poser ses propres questions et demander des précisions sur ce qu'on n'a pas compris.

aa0d701356910041193d3ade295ad16e6963abbc.english: In short, genuine knowledge is possible without travelling, even though it remains different from firsthand experience. Travel can complement it, but it is not essential.
aa0d701356910041193d3ade295ad16e6963abbc.french: Bref, une connaissance réelle est possible sans voyager, même si elle reste différente de l'expérience sur place. Le voyage peut la compléter, mais il n'est pas indispensable.
aa0d701356910041193d3ade295ad16e6963abbc.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

b68ad043f376ddc16dd6238096aa22a5d68c4bad.english: A book or a documentary can tell the story of a tradition and showcase a region’s specialities. We have access to these stories and explanations without needing to travel.
b68ad043f376ddc16dd6238096aa22a5d68c4bad.french: Un livre ou un documentaire peut raconter l'histoire d'une tradition et présenter les produits d'une région. On a accès à ces récits et à ces explications sans qu'on ait besoin de voyager.

b8186719a5fffc73557017deeee3abfdf7c66cfb.english: We discover not only a recipe but also what it tells us about a region.
b8186719a5fffc73557017deeee3abfdf7c66cfb.french: On ne découvre pas seulement une recette, mais aussi ce qu'elle raconte d'une région.
b8186719a5fffc73557017deeee3abfdf7c66cfb.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

c5936eb4dc4bf90ea8a0a9427cae57903bb0a64e.english: Yes, we can genuinely learn about other cultures without travelling. The aim isn't to know everything about a country. It's to understand some of its customs and what they mean. Resources and conversations available from home already make this kind of learning possible.
c5936eb4dc4bf90ea8a0a9427cae57903bb0a64e.french: Oui, on peut réellement connaître d'autres cultures sans voyager. Le but, ce n'est pas de tout connaître du pays. C'est de comprendre quelques habitudes et ce qu'elles veulent dire. Les ressources et les échanges accessibles depuis chez soi permettent déjà cet apprentissage.
c5936eb4dc4bf90ea8a0a9427cae57903bb0a64e.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed, conversational cultural-discovery introduction and general nuance. Previous exact-text translations retained.

cbdc912e9a981f064e091327e2cfec871f84ac7a.english: In this way, we discover local produce and the history behind a dish, not just the steps in a recipe.
cbdc912e9a981f064e091327e2cfec871f84ac7a.french: On découvre ainsi des produits de la région et l'histoire d'un plat, pas seulement les étapes d'une recette.

dbc9ca91552b8bc6e6a6208436808cd94fa1e058.english: Although these ways of learning are useful, they do not fully replace first-hand experience. When we travel, we also discover the smells and the pace of everyday life. But not everyone can travel. These other ways of learning therefore remain valuable.
dbc9ca91552b8bc6e6a6208436808cd94fa1e058.french: Bien que ces moyens soient utiles, ils ne remplacent pas complètement l'expérience sur place. En voyage, on découvre aussi les odeurs et le rythme de la vie quotidienne. Mais tout le monde ne peut pas voyager. Ces autres moyens gardent donc toute leur valeur.
dbc9ca91552b8bc6e6a6208436808cd94fa1e058.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed, conversational cultural-discovery introduction and general nuance. Previous exact-text translations retained.

dca5213441aa03da1ebf6847702df8adf8c7f763.english: During a video call, I could ask a Japanese friend why she takes her shoes off when she gets home. She would explain that her family sometimes sits on the floor and therefore prefers to keep it clean. I would understand this custom better.
dca5213441aa03da1ebf6847702df8adf8c7f763.french: Pendant un appel vidéo, je pourrais demander à une amie japonaise pourquoi elle enlève ses chaussures en rentrant chez elle. Elle m'expliquerait que sa famille s'assoit parfois au sol et préfère donc le garder propre. Je comprendrais mieux cette habitude.

f4b3e29df78f6b24ac0c9bf0a2e9edc31bc24499.english: In my opinion, it is possible to truly get to know other cultures without travelling. Books and documentaries, meeting people locally and having conversations from afar allow us to discover customs and understand them better.
f4b3e29df78f6b24ac0c9bf0a2e9edc31bc24499.french: À mon avis, on peut vraiment connaître d'autres cultures sans voyager. Les livres et les documentaires, les rencontres près de chez soi et les conversations à distance permettent de découvrir des habitudes et de mieux les comprendre.

087bfdd7c00d78d828ab0fb2a79c29cb74c483f7.english: Ingredients and techniques are linked to the produce available, the seasons and trade. An old family recipe can therefore help us understand how people used to live and how they preserved food.
087bfdd7c00d78d828ab0fb2a79c29cb74c483f7.french: Les ingrédients et les techniques sont liés aux produits disponibles, aux saisons et aux échanges. Une ancienne recette familiale peut ainsi aider à comprendre comment on vivait et comment on conservait la nourriture.

142ac4f59fa714a8f27107af1ecc1475f0dc4792.english: In this way, we discover local culinary expertise before we can discuss it with ease.
142ac4f59fa714a8f27107af1ecc1475f0dc4792.french: On découvre ainsi un savoir-faire culinaire local avant de pouvoir en discuter facilement.

168732fcaa3da3bf2ae7acf221d67daccb7ec11a.deepl_english: You can watch a traditional dish being prepared and taste the result, even if you don’t understand all the explanations. By taking part, you learn the techniques by doing them yourself, with someone to guide you.
168732fcaa3da3bf2ae7acf221d67daccb7ec11a.english: We can watch a traditional dish being prepared and taste the result, even if we do not understand all the explanations. By taking part, we learn the techniques by practising them ourselves, with someone to guide us.
168732fcaa3da3bf2ae7acf221d67daccb7ec11a.french: On peut observer la préparation d'un plat traditionnel et goûter le résultat, même si l'on ne comprend pas toutes les explications. En y participant, on apprend les gestes en les faisant soi-même, avec quelqu'un pour nous guider.
168732fcaa3da3bf2ae7acf221d67daccb7ec11a.review_note: Preserve the collective on/we viewpoint and render learning practical cooking actions naturally.

1f983cc91af424e275a093423ab551994721dad4.deepl_english: While staying with a family, a traveller is surprised to find that dinner is served at 9 pm. His host explains that his wife finishes work late and that they wait for her to come home before eating together.
1f983cc91af424e275a093423ab551994721dad4.english: As a guest at a family’s home, a traveller is surprised to find that dinner is served at 9 pm. His host explains that his wife finishes work late and that they wait for her to come home before eating together.
1f983cc91af424e275a093423ab551994721dad4.french: Invité chez une famille, un voyageur s'étonne qu'on dîne à vingt et une heures. Son hôte lui explique que sa femme finit tard et qu'ils attendent qu'elle soit rentrée pour manger ensemble.
1f983cc91af424e275a093423ab551994721dad4.review_note: Invité chez une famille means invited to their home, not necessarily staying with them.

2044ee9b28f63ca7c26c7099ce5fa53afa6f502d.english: During a stay in Ghana, I might learn how to make fufu with my host, even without speaking their language very well. They would show me how to pound the cassava. By having a go myself, I would discover this way of cooking.
2044ee9b28f63ca7c26c7099ce5fa53afa6f502d.french: Pendant un séjour au Ghana, je pourrais apprendre à préparer du fufu avec mon hôte, même sans bien parler sa langue. Il me montrerait comment piler le manioc. En essayant à mon tour, je découvrirais cette façon de cuisiner.

2bbc925f301c3b1c45704a0823b697752200f3b5.english: However, a single dish or restaurant does not represent an entire country. Customs vary depending on the region, the family and the budget. To gain a deeper understanding, we must also explore the language, history and everyday life.
2bbc925f301c3b1c45704a0823b697752200f3b5.french: Cependant, un plat ou un restaurant ne montre pas tout un pays. Les habitudes changent selon les régions, les familles et le budget. Pour aller plus loin, il faut qu'on découvre aussi la langue, l'histoire et la vie de tous les jours.

2c49b45ebf06e9bf5c7c31856ccb622bbd08bde4.english: First and foremost, meals help us to understand certain ways of life.
2c49b45ebf06e9bf5c7c31856ccb622bbd08bde4.french: Tout d'abord, les repas permettent de comprendre certaines habitudes de vie.

398473cd9d85ae66cf0ee0a4531639ef96e9fd22.deepl_english: In Portugal, a visitor is tasting a dish made with salted and dried fish. The chef explains that the fish was salted and dried so that it could be preserved during long sea voyages.
398473cd9d85ae66cf0ee0a4531639ef96e9fd22.english: In Portugal, a visitor tastes a dish made with salted and dried fish. The cook explains that people salted and dried fish to keep it during long sea voyages.
398473cd9d85ae66cf0ee0a4531639ef96e9fd22.french: Au Portugal, un visiteur goûte un plat fait avec du poisson salé et séché. Le cuisinier lui explique qu'on salait et séchait le poisson pour le garder pendant les longs voyages en mer.
398473cd9d85ae66cf0ee0a4531639ef96e9fd22.review_note: Keep the cook's unspecified status and the source's simple illustrative tense; do not imply a professional chef.

40baf4607c3433f407886af81d5f917671a71717.deepl_english: Meals aren’t just about nourishment: they can also be a time spent together. By sharing a meal with locals, we discover what time they eat, with whom, and how they share their food.
40baf4607c3433f407886af81d5f917671a71717.english: Meals are not just about nourishment: they can also be a chance to spend time together. By sharing a meal with local people, we discover what time they eat, who they eat with and how they share the dishes.
40baf4607c3433f407886af81d5f917671a71717.french: Les repas ne servent pas seulement à se nourrir : ils peuvent aussi être un moment passé ensemble. En partageant un repas avec des habitants, on découvre à quelle heure ils mangent, avec qui et comment ils partagent les plats.
40baf4607c3433f407886af81d5f917671a71717.review_note: Render un moment passé ensemble naturally and make the eating companions and shared dishes explicit.

40f02b98c629e39e611f7374b62b38ea1e1cb8cd.english: In Senegal, a visitor shares a meal with a family. Everyone eats from the same large dish of rice and fish. The hosts explain that this evening meal gives them a chance to get together and talk after work.
40f02b98c629e39e611f7374b62b38ea1e1cb8cd.french: Au Sénégal, un visiteur partage un repas avec une famille. Tout le monde mange dans le même grand plat de riz et de poisson. Ses hôtes lui expliquent que ce repas du soir leur permet de se retrouver et de discuter après le travail.
40f02b98c629e39e611f7374b62b38ea1e1cb8cd.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed cuisine opening and clearer shared-meal and preservation examples. Existing translation history retained.

42699d2ce13fc1511a2a957ecaf7cf68f59340e2.english: Meals do not merely show what people eat. They also reveal ways of serving and eating that are passed down from one generation to the next.
42699d2ce13fc1511a2a957ecaf7cf68f59340e2.french: Les repas ne montrent pas seulement ce qu'on mange. Ils font aussi découvrir des façons de servir et de manger qu'on se transmet entre générations.

4392047831226b6811c5587acb96c325d8100a50.english: Meal times can reflect the rhythm of work. The time spent eating together can also reveal the importance placed on family interaction. It is therefore not just what we eat that tells us something, but also how meals are organised.
4392047831226b6811c5587acb96c325d8100a50.french: Les horaires des repas peuvent refléter le rythme du travail. Le temps qu'on prend pour manger ensemble peut aussi montrer la place donnée aux échanges en famille. Ce n'est donc pas seulement ce qu'on mange qui nous renseigne, mais aussi l'organisation des repas.

45e8da5754f1dc0d7bd3b32ac92d9d2d7271fa11.english: Yes, cuisine can help us discover part of a country’s culture. Meals reveal certain ways of life, recipes tell a story, and we can also learn by cooking for ourselves. But simply tasting a dish is not enough to understand everything.
45e8da5754f1dc0d7bd3b32ac92d9d2d7271fa11.french: Oui, la cuisine peut nous faire découvrir une partie de la culture d'un pays. Les repas montrent certaines habitudes de vie, les recettes racontent une histoire, et on peut aussi apprendre en cuisinant soi-même. Mais goûter un plat ne suffit pas à tout comprendre.

511edc4b0d1f0ba02c3b4e9dc0c0c70f7d58be72.english: Furthermore, recipes can tell the story of a place.
511edc4b0d1f0ba02c3b4e9dc0c0c70f7d58be72.french: Ensuite, les recettes peuvent raconter l'histoire d'un lieu.

513f75b365ca64ded69684f934997f5f80615807.english: Meal times give an idea of the rhythm of life. Within a family, the choice to eat together – even late in the evening – also shows the importance placed on these shared moments.
513f75b365ca64ded69684f934997f5f80615807.french: Les heures des repas donnent une idée du rythme de vie. Dans une famille, le choix de manger ensemble, même tard, montre aussi la place qu'on accorde à ces moments partagés.

5278f7d06c13c355de42880adc937671510f4a8b.english: In Portugal, salted and dried fish is easy to find. In the past, this method helped preserve fish during long sea voyages. Fish prepared this way is still used in many recipes today.
5278f7d06c13c355de42880adc937671510f4a8b.french: Au Portugal, on trouve facilement du poisson salé et séché. Autrefois, cette méthode permettait de conserver le poisson pendant les longs voyages en mer. On l'utilise encore aujourd'hui dans de nombreuses recettes.
5278f7d06c13c355de42880adc937671510f4a8b.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed cuisine opening and clearer shared-meal and preservation examples. Existing translation history retained.

54a384a5cff2a7880383f9a0d10ee8cbbc6e7b90.english: However, a single dish or restaurant does not represent an entire country. Customs vary depending on the region, the family and their means. To gain a deeper understanding, one must also explore the language, history and other aspects of daily life.
54a384a5cff2a7880383f9a0d10ee8cbbc6e7b90.french: Cependant, un plat ou un restaurant ne représente pas tout un pays. Les habitudes varient selon les régions, les familles et leurs moyens. Pour aller plus loin, il faut aussi découvrir la langue, l'histoire et d'autres aspects de la vie quotidienne.

59c3c87a394e17574be1c02c23b7ef0e5a78ac7a.english: In this way, we discover how this family adapted to the seasons, not just what they liked to eat.
59c3c87a394e17574be1c02c23b7ef0e5a78ac7a.french: On découvre ainsi comment cette famille s'adaptait aux saisons, pas seulement ce qu'elle aimait manger.

5c41efe953d82e1d422a5337b25be52692081f5c.deepl_english: In Senegal, a visitor is tasting a traditional dish of rice and fish. His host is showing him how to eat it with his hands, without dropping any rice.
5c41efe953d82e1d422a5337b25be52692081f5c.english: In Senegal, a visitor tastes a traditional rice-and-fish dish. The host shows them how to eat it by hand, without dropping any rice.

c31b6026e2c00079231947db089b178454a8e295.french: La lecture aide beaucoup à se cultiver, mais je ne pense pas qu'elle soit indispensable. On peut aussi apprendre en écoutant une conférence ou en pratiquant une activité. Ce qui compte, c'est de comprendre ce qu'on découvre et de faire des liens.

c7e89ed9638e09cceec60fe312ed8859b51c9d03.english: Workshops enable you to learn a craft and discover its history. By taking part, you learn the techniques by doing them yourself, with someone to guide you.
c7e89ed9638e09cceec60fe312ed8859b51c9d03.french: Les ateliers permettent d'apprendre un savoir-faire et de découvrir son histoire. En y participant, on apprend les gestes en les faisant soi-même, avec quelqu'un pour nous guider.

cdb445ca0906a23372b548716c147684e98a61f6.english: Someone watches a documentary about Picasso's Guernica. Close-ups show the figures crying out, then the commentary explains the bombing that inspired the painting. They then understand why this work condemns the violence of war.
cdb445ca0906a23372b548716c147684e98a61f6.french: Une personne regarde un documentaire sur Guernica de Picasso. Des gros plans montrent les personnages qui crient, puis le commentaire explique le bombardement qui a inspiré le tableau. Elle comprend ainsi pourquoi cette œuvre dénonce la violence de la guerre.
cdb445ca0906a23372b548716c147684e98a61f6.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Culture revision; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

cfe4e0f9ce5edd0e13518a3fe5f8df4477600357.deepl_english: In conclusion, reading is not essential to being cultured. It remains very useful, but listening, discussion and practice also enable us to understand and learn. These ways of cultivating oneself can complement one another.
cfe4e0f9ce5edd0e13518a3fe5f8df4477600357.english: In conclusion, reading is not essential to being cultured. It remains very useful, but listening, discussion and practice also enable us to understand and learn. These ways of developing one’s cultural knowledge can complement one another.
cfe4e0f9ce5edd0e13518a3fe5f8df4477600357.french: En conclusion, la lecture n'est pas indispensable pour être cultivé. Elle reste très utile, mais l'écoute, les échanges et la pratique permettent aussi de comprendre et d'apprendre. Ces façons de se cultiver peuvent se compléter.
cfe4e0f9ce5edd0e13518a3fe5f8df4477600357.review_note: Cultivating oneself is an unnatural literal rendering of se cultiver.

d4958b12d16ae78abe802be353949b1dca9b210a.english: I understand why reading is associated with culture: it helps us think and explore a subject in depth. But I do not think it is essential to being cultured. Other ways of learning also deserve recognition.
d4958b12d16ae78abe802be353949b1dca9b210a.french: Je comprends qu'on associe la lecture à la culture : elle aide à réfléchir et à approfondir un sujet. Mais je ne pense pas qu'elle soit indispensable pour être cultivé. D'autres façons d'apprendre méritent aussi d'être reconnues.
d4958b12d16ae78abe802be353949b1dca9b210a.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

d51f9477d0a0bd3262d635819a56fc84c5d2ac05.english: In a pottery workshop, a craftsman demonstrates how to trace a leaf pattern onto a bowl. He explains that his grandmother used to decorate festive dinner plates in this way. The participants reproduce the pattern and discover this family tradition, without having to consult a book.
d51f9477d0a0bd3262d635819a56fc84c5d2ac05.french: Dans un atelier de poterie, un artisan montre comment tracer un motif de feuilles sur un bol. Il raconte que sa grand-mère décorait ainsi les plats des repas de fête. Les participants reproduisent le motif et découvrent cette tradition familiale, sans passer par un livre.

e1a737d9f4cefd435874bcd08933d7b8819e82b7.english: Reading an essay requires you to follow the thread across several pages. To understand the author’s point of view, you must follow their arguments, but also the objections they examine.
e1a737d9f4cefd435874bcd08933d7b8819e82b7.french: Lire un essai demande de garder le fil sur plusieurs pages. Pour comprendre le point de vue de l'auteur, il faut suivre ses arguments, mais aussi les objections qu'il examine.

0601608d8736923d3aae75523619829fab53efb0.english: For example, a father repeats to his child a proverb that his grandmother used to say to him often. When the child asks him what it means, the father hesitates: after years of not using it, he has forgotten its meaning.
0601608d8736923d3aae75523619829fab53efb0.french: Par exemple, un père répète à son enfant un proverbe que sa grand-mère lui disait souvent. Quand l'enfant lui demande ce qu'il signifie, le père hésite : après des années sans l'utiliser, il en a oublié le sens.

076152cad04e62badea5911822056859e47802a3.english: Furthermore, one may also lose certain skills linked to family traditions.
076152cad04e62badea5911822056859e47802a3.french: Ensuite, on peut aussi perdre certains savoir-faire liés aux traditions familiales.

105cc5a435832469b04669cae3a7e1738effda1d.english: Finally, regular contact can help preserve these points of reference despite the passing of time.
105cc5a435832469b04669cae3a7e1738effda1d.french: Enfin, des contacts réguliers peuvent préserver ces repères malgré les années.

1256e131eca72b3868979bfecd3abec4c00524d5.english: However, maintaining this connection also depends on time, resources and family history. Adopting other habits does not necessarily mean forgetting one's origins. Sometimes people change their lives while remaining attached to what they want to preserve and pass on.
1256e131eca72b3868979bfecd3abec4c00524d5.french: Cependant, entretenir ce lien dépend aussi du temps, des ressources et de l'histoire familiale. Adopter d'autres habitudes n'est pas nécessairement oublier ses origines. Il arrive qu'on change de vie tout en restant attaché à ce qu'on veut conserver et transmettre.
1256e131eca72b3868979bfecd3abec4c00524d5.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

1e48330643e4d062c41620d1918819d957596373.english: She therefore needs to relearn these steps so that she can pass this dance on to her children.
1e48330643e4d062c41620d1918819d957596373.french: Elle a donc besoin de réapprendre ces pas pour pouvoir transmettre cette danse à ses enfants.

2355c9e7d7e4ab0cf82bee9fcdb11ecdda8adb9c.english: For example, a mother tries to show her children a traditional dance she used to know well. After years without practising it, she recognises the music but can no longer remember certain steps. Her sister shows her the steps again.
2355c9e7d7e4ab0cf82bee9fcdb11ecdda8adb9c.french: Par exemple, une mère essaie de montrer à ses enfants une danse traditionnelle qu'elle connaissait bien. Après des années sans la pratiquer, elle reconnaît la musique, mais ne retrouve plus certains pas. Sa sœur les lui montre à nouveau.

3349183c510645bd7609ba4f2ef035a3e616b5be.english: In conclusion, words and skills can be forgotten through lack of practice. But maintained ties and activities matter more than the years: living far away does not necessarily mean losing everything.
3349183c510645bd7609ba4f2ef035a3e616b5be.french: En conclusion, mots et savoir-faire peuvent s'oublier faute de pratique. Mais les liens et les activités maintenus comptent davantage que les années : vivre loin ne veut pas forcément dire tout perdre.
3349183c510645bd7609ba4f2ef035a3e616b5be.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

38311de6a956a3715eb4dead2ddfb467c55c0197.english: But regular contact can preserve these reference points despite the passing years.
38311de6a956a3715eb4dead2ddfb467c55c0197.french: Mais des contacts réguliers peuvent préserver ces repères malgré les années.
38311de6a956a3715eb4dead2ddfb467c55c0197.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

3dc5c80188742213a8a36a1568db515b67438f93.english: Phone calls, visits and shared celebrations provide opportunities to practise one’s language and traditions. One can also ask for clarification and rediscover a forgotten word or gesture.
3dc5c80188742213a8a36a1568db515b67438f93.french: Les appels, les visites et les fêtes partagées offrent des occasions de pratiquer sa langue et ses traditions. On peut aussi demander une précision et retrouver un mot ou un geste oublié.

4711ca0e3012d4871b7bfd3cb6dd620f4ca997a7.english: In conclusion, a long life abroad can lead to the forgetting of words or skills that are used less frequently. This risk also depends on the connections and activities one maintains, not just on the number of years spent abroad.
4711ca0e3012d4871b7bfd3cb6dd620f4ca997a7.french: En conclusion, une longue vie à l'étranger peut faire oublier des mots ou des savoir-faire moins pratiqués. Ce risque dépend aussi des liens et des activités maintenus, pas seulement du nombre d'années.

5598e46f9f3d58b97c5ef7d266063296031f5943.english: First of all, when you use your native language less, you may end up forgetting certain words and expressions.
5598e46f9f3d58b97c5ef7d266063296031f5943.french: Tout d'abord, quand on utilise moins sa langue d'origine, on peut finir par oublier certains mots et certaines expressions.

79d6ffb523589e431a3addc0516540bc44c4d59f.deepl_english: Yes, living abroad for a long time can lead to forgetting certain aspects of one’s culture of origin. But this forgetting is not automatic. When you continue to speak your language and practise certain traditions with your loved ones, you keep them in your daily life and are less likely to forget them.
79d6ffb523589e431a3addc0516540bc44c4d59f.english: Yes, living abroad for a long time can lead to forgetting certain aspects of one’s culture of origin. But this does not happen automatically. When you continue to speak your language and practise certain traditions with your loved ones, you keep them in your daily life and are less likely to forget them.
79d6ffb523589e431a3addc0516540bc44c4d59f.french: Oui, vivre longtemps à l'étranger peut entraîner l'oubli de certains éléments de sa culture d'origine. Mais cet oubli n'est pas automatique. Quand on continue à parler sa langue et à pratiquer certaines traditions avec ses proches, on les garde dans sa vie quotidienne et on risque moins de les oublier.
79d6ffb523589e431a3addc0516540bc44c4d59f.review_note: This forgetting is not automatic is an unnatural literal construction.

8bf1b8a374e6d573031e7fd68e184604b509ffcb.english: However, maintaining this connection does not depend solely on willpower: time, resources and family history also play a part. Adopting different habits does not necessarily mean forgetting one’s roots. Everyone should be able to develop their identity without being accused of betraying their culture.
8bf1b8a374e6d573031e7fd68e184604b509ffcb.french: Cependant, entretenir ce lien ne dépend pas seulement de la volonté : le temps, les ressources et l'histoire familiale comptent aussi. Adopter d'autres habitudes n'est pas nécessairement oublier ses origines. Chacun doit pouvoir faire évoluer son identité sans qu'on l'accuse de trahir sa culture.

8dbdf181c973484812c4eef0ec3682edf276a26c.deepl_english: Certain customs are better retained when practised regularly with loved ones. When far from them, one may have fewer opportunities to practise and may gradually forget how to do things, even if one continues to speak one’s native language.
8dbdf181c973484812c4eef0ec3682edf276a26c.english: Certain movements are easier to remember when practised regularly with loved ones. When far from them, one may have fewer opportunities to practise and may gradually forget how to do things, even if one continues to speak one’s native language.
8dbdf181c973484812c4eef0ec3682edf276a26c.french: On retient mieux certains gestes quand on les refait régulièrement avec ses proches. Loin d'eux, on peut avoir moins d'occasions de pratiquer et oublier peu à peu comment faire, même si l'on continue à parler sa langue d'origine.
8dbdf181c973484812c4eef0ec3682edf276a26c.review_note: Gestes here refers to practical movements or skills, illustrated by dance steps, rather than customs generally.

ce1be49e2339bfcd570d24400070ad31811dd0ec.english: The length of one’s stay is therefore not enough to predict what will be retained or forgotten.
ce1be49e2339bfcd570d24400070ad31811dd0ec.french: La durée du séjour ne suffit donc pas à prévoir ce qui sera gardé ou oublié.

e4fbb006ca8d43f1a45a0a01cd81dc3956d07fa4.english: For example, someone who has been living abroad for twenty years phones her sister every week in their family language. These conversations allow her to continue using expressions she rarely hears at work.
e4fbb006ca8d43f1a45a0a01cd81dc3956d07fa4.french: Par exemple, une personne installée depuis vingt ans à l'étranger téléphone chaque semaine à sa sœur dans leur langue familiale. Ces échanges lui permettent de continuer à utiliser des expressions qu'elle entend rarement au travail.

e806032bf40a9a9eb513c3f05e160ecd96abd957.english: Some expressions were familiar during childhood. If another language takes up almost all of daily life, we use them less and their meaning can become less clear, to the point of being forgotten.
e806032bf40a9a9eb513c3f05e160ecd96abd957.french: Certaines expressions étaient familières pendant l'enfance. Si une autre langue occupe presque toute la vie quotidienne, on les emploie moins et leur sens peut devenir moins clair, jusqu'à s'oublier.
e806032bf40a9a9eb513c3f05e160ecd96abd957.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

e98b629d9d43adb3f0c14c16ca361722b672b35c.english: Yes, living abroad for a long time can lead to forgetting certain elements of one's culture of origin. But this forgetting is not automatic. By continuing to speak one's language and practise certain traditions with those close to us, we are less likely to forget them.
e98b629d9d43adb3f0c14c16ca361722b672b35c.french: Oui, vivre longtemps à l'étranger peut entraîner l'oubli de certains éléments de sa culture d'origine. Mais cet oubli n'est pas automatique. En continuant à parler sa langue et à pratiquer certaines traditions avec ses proches, on risque moins de les oublier.
e98b629d9d43adb3f0c14c16ca361722b672b35c.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

f2d47eb68de8e2e139e9f63a4d088082b5d71159.english: Such lapses can therefore complicate the passing on of certain aspects of family culture.
f2d47eb68de8e2e139e9f63a4d088082b5d71159.french: Ces oublis peuvent donc compliquer la transmission d'une partie de la culture familiale.

ff72965dfb95ac58d80ca65c0ba60a37474e8443.english: When you mainly use another language in everyday life, you may have fewer opportunities to use the expressions from your childhood. Over time, you risk forgetting their meaning.
ff72965dfb95ac58d80ca65c0ba60a37474e8443.french: Quand on utilise surtout une autre langue au quotidien, on peut avoir moins d'occasions d'employer les expressions de son enfance. Avec le temps, on risque d'en oublier le sens.

08730b2651c511adf31abd3fb153e61d3b32de41.english: When a contestant makes the others laugh by mocking someone, the humiliation can come across as just a joke. A young person might then be tempted to imitate this behaviour to make their friends laugh.
08730b2651c511adf31abd3fb153e61d3b32de41.french: Quand un candidat fait rire les autres en se moquant de quelqu'un, l'humiliation peut passer pour une simple plaisanterie. Un jeune peut alors avoir envie d'imiter ce comportement pour faire rire ses amis.

0cedd779d2a5eb2b564094f1d4b4d288003c8dd0.english: Furthermore, some programmes may trivialise aggressive behaviour.
0cedd779d2a5eb2b564094f1d4b4d288003c8dd0.french: Ensuite, certaines émissions peuvent banaliser les comportements agressifs.

222edf607c8fc20f1fb0912ffa47555bd6dbce7c.deepl_english: During the break, a teenager mimics a joke from the programme to make his friends laugh. But the friend who is the target of the joke feels humiliated and walks away from the group.
222edf607c8fc20f1fb0912ffa47555bd6dbce7c.english: During the break, a teenager repeats a mocking remark from the programme to make his friends laugh. But the schoolmate who is the target of the remark feels humiliated and walks away from the group.
222edf607c8fc20f1fb0912ffa47555bd6dbce7c.french: À la pause, un adolescent reprend une moquerie de l'émission pour faire rire ses amis. Mais le camarade visé se sent humilié et s'éloigne du groupe.
222edf607c8fc20f1fb0912ffa47555bd6dbce7c.review_note: Moquerie is a mocking remark, not simply a joke, and camarade does not establish friendship.

29d939c05392e8d6cc31e7ca3bf381275fd41e05.english: What makes for good entertainment on screen is therefore not necessarily acceptable in real life.
29d939c05392e8d6cc31e7ca3bf381275fd41e05.french: Ce qui fait le spectacle à l'écran n'est donc pas forcément acceptable dans la vie.

5e2b33a6db962ddd0c177b9a507f3a80cc06022d.english: First and foremost, these programmes can present a misleading picture of success.
5e2b33a6db962ddd0c177b9a507f3a80cc06022d.french: Tout d'abord, ces émissions peuvent donner une image trompeuse de la réussite.

773e030cc2c88e73c7ce3f78489b15888b0a0b86.english: In conclusion, I do not condemn all reality TV, but its effects deserve attention. Discussing it helps young people distinguish what is turned into a spectacle from their own lives, without taking contestants as models in everything.
773e030cc2c88e73c7ce3f78489b15888b0a0b86.french: En conclusion, je ne condamne pas toute la télé-réalité, mais ses effets méritent de l'attention. En discuter aide les jeunes à distinguer ce qui est mis en spectacle de leur propre vie, sans prendre les candidats pour des modèles en tout.
773e030cc2c88e73c7ce3f78489b15888b0a0b86.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

7d166b3a0d54746e63293bc88e1a53c7bfdaf023.english: When contestants gain attention by insulting or mocking others, disrespect can look like a way to be funny or stand out. Over time, young viewers may pay more attention to the joke than to the person being hurt.
7d166b3a0d54746e63293bc88e1a53c7bfdaf023.french: Quand des candidats attirent l'attention en insultant ou en se moquant des autres, le manque de respect peut sembler être une façon de faire rire ou de se faire remarquer. À force, un jeune peut prêter plus d'attention à la plaisanterie qu'à la personne blessée.
7d166b3a0d54746e63293bc88e1a53c7bfdaf023.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed and approved reality-TV normalisation argument. Existing translation history is retained; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated.

847e44baeddf1cb540a6049183583b73a4f8a396.english: This can lead them to underestimate the value of their studies and their work.
847e44baeddf1cb540a6049183583b73a4f8a396.french: Cela peut lui faire sous-estimer la valeur de ses études et de son travail.

8880abb74fff1ede459b71ecb8fb9ab1eb757a2f.english: In conclusion, I would not condemn all these programmes. But we need to discuss them so that young people can distinguish between the show and their own lives, in their plans, relationships and purchases.
8880abb74fff1ede459b71ecb8fb9ab1eb757a2f.french: En conclusion, je ne condamnerais pas toutes ces émissions. Mais il faut en discuter pour que les jeunes puissent distinguer le spectacle de leur propre vie, dans leurs projets, leurs relations et leurs achats.

8a0c90a40218610b08fa05c47997d830eda1d3b9.english: For example, a programme might replay a contestant's remark about another participant's appearance among its funniest moments. The laughter is highlighted, but the targeted person's discomfort is barely acknowledged.
8a0c90a40218610b08fa05c47997d830eda1d3b9.french: Par exemple, une émission peut reprendre une remarque sur le physique d'un candidat parmi ses moments les plus drôles. On met en avant les rires, mais on montre à peine le malaise de la personne visée.
8a0c90a40218610b08fa05c47997d830eda1d3b9.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed and approved reality-TV normalisation argument. Existing translation history is retained; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated.

8b00cc634da523f8adf37c58ae7a0588f7f38574.deepl_english: A teenager orders the shoes recommended by a contestant they like. The contestant presents them as their favourites. After the purchase, they notice the words ‘paid partnership’: the brand had paid the contestant to talk about them.
8b00cc634da523f8adf37c58ae7a0588f7f38574.english: A teenager orders the shoes recommended by a contestant they like. The contestant presents them as their favourites. After the purchase, the teenager notices the words ‘paid partnership’: the brand had paid the contestant to talk about the shoes.
8b00cc634da523f8adf37c58ae7a0588f7f38574.french: Un adolescent commande les chaussures recommandées par un candidat qu'il aime bien. Celui-ci les présente comme ses préférées. Après l'achat, il remarque la mention « partenariat rémunéré » : la marque avait payé le candidat pour en parler.
8b00cc634da523f8adf37c58ae7a0588f7f38574.review_note: The teenager notices the disclosure; they after The contestant leaves that antecedent unclear.

9db61b0c2163b280404bd376a866a548e84ae272.english: We see holidays, stylish clothes and festive occasions, but far less of the hard work or the difficulties. A young person might end up believing that being famous and living in luxury is what success is all about.
9db61b0c2163b280404bd376a866a548e84ae272.french: On voit des voyages, de beaux vêtements et des moments de fête, mais beaucoup moins le travail ou les difficultés. Un jeune peut finir par croire qu'être connu et vivre dans le luxe, c'est cela, réussir.

9f19e9cc2c49cb7ae22cd2672fa8588be0ca8e11.english: However, not all young people take these programmes seriously. They may watch them for entertainment without wanting to imitate the contestants. Discussing the editing, the behaviour and the advertising also helps to maintain a critical perspective.
9f19e9cc2c49cb7ae22cd2672fa8588be0ca8e11.french: Cependant, tous les jeunes ne prennent pas ces émissions au sérieux. On peut les regarder pour se distraire sans vouloir imiter les candidats. Discuter du montage, des comportements et de la publicité aide aussi à garder un regard critique.

a7902cf141991845f71442d19f7300637afda293.deepl_english: A sixth-former watches a contestant on holiday in a villa with a swimming pool. By comparing these images with his school lessons and his weekend part-time job, he finds his own life disappointing, even though he is only seeing selected moments.
a7902cf141991845f71442d19f7300637afda293.english: A high-school student watches a contestant on holiday in a villa with a swimming pool. By comparing these images with his school lessons and his weekend part-time job, he finds his own life disappointing, even though he is only seeing selected moments.
a7902cf141991845f71442d19f7300637afda293.french: Un lycéen regarde un candidat en vacances dans une villa avec piscine. En comparant ces images à ses cours et à son petit boulot du week-end, il trouve sa propre vie décevante, alors qu'il voit seulement des moments choisis.
a7902cf141991845f71442d19f7300637afda293.review_note: Translate lycéen as high-school student; the source does not specify the narrower sixth-form stage.

ab09892dfa440a39b60010082316cb958b7ca99c.english: However, some young people watch these programmes for entertainment without wanting to imitate the contestants. Although they sometimes know how to take a step back, repetition can make these models more familiar. The risk also depends on critical judgement and discussions.
ab09892dfa440a39b60010082316cb958b7ca99c.french: Cependant, des jeunes regardent ces émissions pour se distraire sans vouloir imiter les candidats. Bien qu'ils sachent parfois prendre du recul, la répétition peut rendre ces modèles plus familiers. Le risque dépend aussi du regard critique et des discussions.
ab09892dfa440a39b60010082316cb958b7ca99c.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the second editorial pass and Culture rewrite; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

b035ecd2ca16bb2a0d10c4510f5acba43b1ac59f.english: I believe that some reality TV programmes can be harmful to young people. I see three main risks in particular: a false image of success, the imitation of harmful behaviour, and purchases encouraged by advertising.
b035ecd2ca16bb2a0d10c4510f5acba43b1ac59f.french: Je pense que certaines émissions de télé-réalité peuvent nuire aux jeunes. Je vois surtout trois risques : une fausse image de la réussite, l'imitation de comportements blessants et des achats encouragés par la publicité.

b21c0f8f076d02c5bd7c0c1b4c0e24ddc219708d.english: I think some reality TV programmes can have a bad influence on young people. The problem is not simply that they entertain: they can present selected moments as a model for life, extending to relationships and purchases.

24b02446a932ccd5a9904405ab0b633406827cb2.english: For example, someone reading a book about Quebec's history can discover how French became established in North America and survived there. This helps them understand the place of the language in current debates.

3511be035bbe60ef475ef35b85bc9a8c284df3b9.english: Travelling is therefore not the only way in.

3919a014ab0ebb3882058bd97c6e5090d0698d5f.english: Someone who cannot afford a trip can borrow a collection of translated stories. They discover the neighbourhoods and occupations described, then consult the suggested references to explore the questions that interest them further.

4111905294a06cb30e966cd071180b3385a52194.english: When they are available in libraries or in translation, they provide access to distant voices. You can read them at your own pace and go back over passages that raise questions.

41bcfde341ca720ce5ebdbeac78ecf7480bfca09.english: A single image or piece of information does not always reveal how a city or an institution came into being. A book can outline the key stages and provide references for further reading.

507bca5b33379862351ae06378cb809207688bcf.english: Travelling takes time and money. At a library, we can borrow books written in other countries, sometimes translated into a language we understand. So we do not have to wait until we can travel to start discovering those countries.

59dea62ecc72f7e71d6717a6b839c7fe9b68ef63.english: Yes, books are a valuable way of getting to know a country, provided you do not treat a single work as a complete portrait. Ils peuvent éclairer son histoire, présenter des expériences différentes et ouvrir cette découverte aux personnes qui ne voyagent pas. La lecture gagne toutefois à croiser les points de vue.

5cc5160e1ec30510e07306f381e98422fefc7cbc.english: So for me, books are a real gateway to a country. They connect its history to the lives of its inhabitants, provided we compare different points of view.
5cc5160e1ec30510e07306f381e98422fefc7cbc.french: Pour moi, les livres sont donc une vraie porte d'entrée vers un pays. Ils relient son histoire aux vies de ses habitants, à condition de croiser les points de vue.

604cded465d266c0d9f53235004fae3b1692c85f.english: Furthermore, these accounts reveal experiences that one might not necessarily encounter oneself.

6cdf16683577c0b0acf1c8d01a45007aa1d98a6c.english: Yes, I agree: reading books is a good way to get to know a country. You can discover much more than its monuments. It does not entirely replace being there, but it would be a shame to see reading as merely preparation for a trip.

a5ee57e1397a317bf76501c9a3b002bc8564eb30.english: Reading thus links present-day places to social history.

ce90571a38aca98d4d218e2ff78824fea7345fd1.english: Finally, books allow you to discover a country without having to travel there.

dce29b17cfe8b7e707ac6d182ea7bf903036d8da.english: A narrative can give us insight into a character’s thoughts, not just their actions. We then understand what matters to them and why they hesitate. This remains their point of view, not that of all the inhabitants.

eddb4c36fc41561d3cebb2e1df290f1b35991f76.review_note: Human-authored English for the Education editorial pass; aligned and reviewed against the complete current French spoken intervention. No DeepL original or provider call was made for this row.

f5ddf25ffb168e6c9d029ca0833e2dabdd8f616e.english: Novels and personal accounts also show life from the inside.

fb6d2cd5626b0656f86b8103b11f3b7e6955a8cb.french: Cependant, un livre peut être ancien, partial ou peu fiable. fdfe9d5cb4c689ad483c941b639977c963ec5fcb.english: First and foremost, a well-researched book can explain the context of a current situation.
fdfe9d5cb4c689ad483c941b639977c963ec5fcb.french: Tout d'abord, un ouvrage documenté peut expliquer le contexte d'une situation actuelle.

013e12c9f620cbc0cec6fc12501006c963cb0634.english: I partly agree. Mobile phones give us very easy access to information, but not always to accurate information. The same device lets us consult a reliable source or receive a rumour. So how we use it matters too.

05138c025152b3802a7ed57caefc1c15aeee8558.english: In conclusion, I appreciate the variety of recipes and shared meals, whilst taking into account the time and budget available. The important thing is to be able to prepare and pass on these dishes, not to say that everything was better in the past.
05138c025152b3802a7ed57caefc1c15aeee8558.french: En conclusion, j'apprécie la variété des recettes et les repas partagés, tout en tenant compte du temps et du budget disponibles. L'important est de pouvoir préparer et transmettre ces plats, pas de dire que tout était meilleur avant.

0852d59dae54578a70629027ffb70247f4524a55.deepl_english: Someone who has the same dish several evenings running can use the leftover vegetables and tinned beans as a base for another dinner. They can enjoy variety with a meal they can actually prepare during the week.
0852d59dae54578a70629027ffb70247f4524a55.english: Someone who has the same ready meal on several evenings can plan a base of vegetables and tinned beans for another dinner. They can enjoy variety with a meal they can actually prepare during the week.
0852d59dae54578a70629027ffb70247f4524a55.french: Une personne qui reprend le même plat préparé plusieurs soirs peut prévoir une base de légumes et des haricots en conserve pour un autre dîner. Elle retrouve de la variété avec une préparation qu'elle peut réellement faire pendant la semaine.

0df1fb2146daa3d43fb08c3cea5d8f2c178b3988.english: However, customs vary from region to region and from family to family. Budget, local shops and food preservation also limit the choices available. Home cooking is not automatically balanced, and shared meals should not become an obligation for those who live alone.
0df1fb2146daa3d43fb08c3cea5d8f2c178b3988.french: Cependant, les habitudes diffèrent selon les régions et les familles. Le budget, les commerces et la conservation limitent aussi les choix. Une cuisine familiale n'est pas automatiquement équilibrée, et il ne faut pas que les repas partagés deviennent une obligation pour ceux qui vivent seuls.

19cabffb0d65429fb856bc12ee5f5e06df27295a.english: A recipe is not just a list of ingredients. Preparing it together allows us to pass on skills and share memories; those who receive it can then adapt it, rather than simply seeing it disappear.
19cabffb0d65429fb856bc12ee5f5e06df27295a.french: Une recette n'est pas seulement une liste d'ingrédients. La préparer ensemble permet de transmettre un savoir-faire et d'échanger des souvenirs ; ceux qui la reçoivent peuvent ensuite l'adapter au lieu de simplement la voir disparaître.

1da3b448efed9d82fc91157ce69bc3d8f7112d92.english: During a family meal, one person might show a younger family member how to make a bean dish. They cook together and note down the steps; the younger person can then make the dish again and share it in turn.
1da3b448efed9d82fc91157ce69bc3d8f7112d92.french: Lors d'un repas familial, une personne peut montrer à un plus jeune comment préparer un plat de haricots. Ils cuisinent ensemble et notent les étapes ; celui-ci peut ensuite refaire le plat et le partager à son tour.

3e481ea275432f329b02d410713b2b27f74d6e9c.english: Furthermore, cooking takes time and equipment.
3e481ea275432f329b02d410713b2b27f74d6e9c.french: Ensuite, cuisiner demande du temps et du matériel.

4ed196a649dd10a0a577cc015c66890b36faa7c5.english: Finally, shared meals can help to keep a culinary culture alive and pass it on to future generations.
4ed196a649dd10a0a577cc015c66890b36faa7c5.french: Enfin, les repas partagés peuvent faire vivre et transmettre une culture culinaire.

87201b8fc8581cfe0cdf0b324bc7d77781e2e163.english: I take a nuanced view of food in my country. I appreciate the variety of recipes and the importance of shared meals, but the quality also depends on the time available for preparation and the means to buy ingredients. I would therefore not describe all families as if they ate in the same way.
87201b8fc8581cfe0cdf0b324bc7d77781e2e163.french: Je porte un regard nuancé sur l'alimentation dans mon pays. J'apprécie la variété des recettes et la place des repas partagés, mais la qualité dépend aussi du temps pour préparer et des moyens pour acheter. Je ne décrirais donc pas toutes les familles comme si elles mangeaient de la même manière.

8e45f3e86dd89fbd3c1a17925b0cf705db58c96d.english: Family or regional recipes provide ideas for using different ingredients. We can adapt them to add variety to our meals, without assuming that a dish is balanced simply because it is traditional.
8e45f3e86dd89fbd3c1a17925b0cf705db58c96d.french: Les recettes familiales ou régionales donnent des idées pour utiliser différents ingrédients. On peut les reprendre et les adapter pour varier les repas, sans supposer qu'un plat est équilibré simplement parce qu'il est traditionnel.

8ff3db0a3156ee5a2321751c0efc78c497f60338.english: Knowing a range of recipes therefore helps to ensure you don’t always cook the same thing.
8ff3db0a3156ee5a2321751c0efc78c497f60338.french: Connaître plusieurs recettes aide donc à ne pas toujours cuisiner la même chose.

9984e88d46a5421806558c5ac82d52b46fc22b64.english: First and foremost, the diversity of recipes offers several ways to put together a meal.
9984e88d46a5421806558c5ac82d52b46fc22b64.french: Tout d'abord, la diversité des recettes offre plusieurs façons de composer un repas.

a527552ab43d233fd093bb1ceeb4c41b948d0787.english: Cooking thus fosters connections and knowledge, going beyond what’s on the plate.
a527552ab43d233fd093bb1ceeb4c41b948d0787.french: La cuisine entretient ainsi des liens et des connaissances, au-delà du contenu de l'assiette.

ade5b60533d7ce684cb6d8c800a67003b76ee5f4.english: Improving our diet requires solutions that are compatible with real life.
ade5b60533d7ce684cb6d8c800a67003b76ee5f4.french: Améliorer l'alimentation demande des solutions compatibles avec la vie réelle.

b37ea194c7c529dd1b2ac7a58f2eab8339646b25.english: A family can take a recipe for rice and beans, then add whatever vegetables they have to hand. This gives them several variations on a familiar dish, rather than always making the same meal.
b37ea194c7c529dd1b2ac7a58f2eab8339646b25.french: Une famille peut reprendre une recette de riz aux haricots, puis y ajouter les légumes disponibles. Elle obtient plusieurs variantes d'un plat connu, au lieu de refaire toujours le même repas.

deddee185fa38bd90bd71906dfa9ec987b57f050.english: Knowing how to cook isn’t enough when you get home late or have limited kitchen equipment. You may end up eating the same dish over and over again, which can sometimes be very salty or lack variety. Well-chosen quick solutions can help, without ruling out all ready-to-use products.
deddee185fa38bd90bd71906dfa9ec987b57f050.french: Savoir cuisiner ne suffit pas lorsqu'on rentre tard ou qu'on dispose de peu d'équipement. On peut finir par reprendre toujours le même plat, parfois très salé ou peu varié. Des solutions rapides bien choisies peuvent aider, sans condamner tous les produits prêts à utiliser.

00b4169eb302bd05195be1dc5b7483bdfe5fa390.english: However, handwriting can be difficult to produce or read, and sending it takes time. A letter may also get lost or damaged.
